dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, what does success mean to you?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌt dʌz səkˈsɛs ˈmiːn tə juː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: For me, success means doing a job I love and helping other people.
dialogue.reading: fər miː, səkˈsɛs ˈmiːnz ˈduːɪŋ ə ˈdʒɑːb aɪ ˈlʌv ənd ˈhɛlpɪŋ ˈʌðər ˈpiːpəl.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's a great answer. And what do you think is the key to success?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈɡreɪt ˈænsər. ənd ˈwʌt duː juː ˈθɪŋk ɪz ðə ˈkiː tə səkˈsɛs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I think the key to succeeding is never giving up.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈθɪŋk ðə ˈkiː tə səkˈsiːdɪŋ ɪz ˈnɛvər ˈɡɪvɪŋ ˈʌp.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And how do you deal with failure?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈhaʊ duː juː ˈdiːl wɪð ˈfeɪljər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It isn't easy. When I failed my first big exam at university, I cried all night.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈɪzənt ˈiːzi. wɛn aɪ ˈfeɪld maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˈbɪɡ ɪɡˈzæm ət ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti, aɪ ˈkraɪd ˈɔːl ˈnaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My mom told me that failure is part of learning. That changed my attitude.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈmɑːm ˈtoʊld miː ðæt ˈfeɪljər ɪz ˈpɑːrt əv ˈlɜːrnɪŋ. ðæt ˈtʃeɪndʒd maɪ ˈætɪtuːd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: She's right. Is positive thinking important to you?
dialogue.reading: ʃiːz ˈraɪt. ɪz ˈpɑːzətɪv ˈθɪŋkɪŋ ɪmˈpɔːrtənt tə juː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, but positive thinking isn't enough. You also need a plan for achieving your goals.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, bʌt ˈpɑːzətɪv ˈθɪŋkɪŋ ˈɪzənt ɪˈnʌf. juː ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈniːd ə ˈplæn fər əˈtʃiːvɪŋ jʊr ˈɡoʊlz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Exactly. So what's your secret of staying positive?
dialogue.reading: ɪɡˈzæktli. soʊ ˈwʌts jʊr ˈsiːkrət əv ˈsteɪɪŋ ˈpɑːzətɪv?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Talking to my family. My little sister always makes me laugh!
dialogue.reading: ˈtɔːkɪŋ tə maɪ ˈfæməli. maɪ ˈlɪtəl ˈsɪstər ˈɔːlweɪz ˈmeɪks miː ˈlæf!
